description: This file defines a generic class BufferGrain<T> implementing IBufferGrain<T> interface, providing message buffering functionalities such as offering messages, sending asynchronously, linking to target grains, and receiving all messages.

classes.name: BufferGrain<T>
classes.description: A generic grain class that buffers messages of type T, implementing methods for message offering, sending, linking, and retrieval.

methods.name: OfferMessage
methods.description: Offers a message to the buffer for processing or acceptance.

methods.name: SendAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds a message of type T to the buffer.

methods.name: SendAsync (overload)
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a message of type T with cancellation support.

methods.name: LinkTo
methods.description: Links this buffer to a target grain.

methods.name: ConsumeMessage
methods.description: Consumes a single message from the buffer.

methods.name: ReceiveAll
methods.description: Retrieves and clears all buffered messages.
